properties.about: Capt’n.ai is an AI-driven digital marketing platform that automates the optimization of online ad campaigns across multiple networks. Jointly developed by Croatian AI startup airt and marketing firm SeekandHit, Capt’n.ai acts like a virtual campaign manager: it pulls in performance data from Google and Facebook ads, analyzes it daily with machine learning, and automatically reallocates budgets and tweaks campaign settings to maximize conversions. By performing cross-platform budget optimization (something neither Google nor Facebook will do across each other’s channels), Capt’n.ai can improve campaign results by up to 25% and save marketers significant time. It also automates report generation for clients, further streamlining the work of advertising agencies. Launched in late 2020, Capt’n.ai enables businesses to run more efficient and effective ad campaigns with minimal manual intervention.
